text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, C.B. It's your birthday, right? Lend 
me your ear... I've got a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a special ride on my plane. 
I can take you anywhere you want. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My driving skills are no half-baked 
affair. You might not have the luxury to 
enjoy the scenery. Heheheh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A trip through the skies with Sirius, 
huh... Fufu. That sounds quite fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if that's the case! Since we have the 
chance, how about our flight route...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Starting from Hokkaido and crossing the 
finish line in Okinawa! That's the route I 
wanna go with!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, wait! Across the length of Japan?! 
What do you think you are, a jet plane or 
something?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—You can go 'wherever' you want. Am I 
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm having the absolute time of my life 
right now! So... don't go spoiling the 
fun, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Fine, I'll play along this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's too late for regrets now. Let's make 
it a fun time, okay, C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Thank you, Sirius! I'm looking 
forward to our journey together too.
